name: supermemory
description: Persistent memory and knowledge layer - search, save and profile memories through the Supermemory MCP, authorized with OAuth.
author: Local developer

interface.shortDescription: Search, save and recall memories with Supermemory
interface.longDescription: Supermemory is the persistent memory and knowledge layer behind a session. Search it before answering anything that depends on a past decision, a stated preference or project history; save the decisions, preferences and architecture facts worth keeping; and curate spaces, container tags and the user profile. The official hosted Supermemory MCP server (OAuth) exposes semantic search, document storage, the profile layer and the memory graph.
